preflight.detail: Measure semantic file/fragment payloads separately from parent setup and platform overhead. Freeze held-out roots before content inspection; raw sources remain local. No automatic core change or scheduled job.

attempts.action: Refresh read-only conversation metadata and freeze a new parent cohort before semantic inspection
attempts.expected_effect: No previously processed or automated root is reused; training and holdout families are disjoint and exact source inputs frozen
attempts.result: Frozen 12 unused parent roots: eight train, four held-out, seven train families, prior 115 roots excluded. Native read_thread recovered 28 train and seven held-out userMessage records with original message IDs; no holdout text emitted to semantic analysis. Prepared input hashes frozen.

attempts.action: Instrument semantic reads and run progressive versus whole-ledger reflection on the same frozen training inputs
attempts.expected_effect: Traceable returned payload counts, independent evidence dispositions, identical current constraints and no forced promotion
attempts.result: Both isolated arms completed on identical bootstrap and training payloads. Sixteen successful payloads passed byte-hash, JSON and token recomputation. Progressive returned 9128 Context tokens versus 15214; both returned 3060 evidence tokens. Both propose zero promotions; observation coverage differs and requires parent reconciliation.

attempts.action: Reconcile direct training evidence, freeze reflection, inspect held-out applicability, validate zero-promotion result and prepare redacted measurements
attempts.expected_effect: Preserve useful observations without unsupported long-term rules; disclose omission and measurement limits; keep core entry unchanged
attempts.result: Frozen final reflection before held-out inspection; 3 reinforced, 4 deferred, 4 rejected, zero promotions validated and applied. Four held-out cases do not establish manual-figure generalization. Core and learned body hashes unchanged; 1823-token core and all loading budgets pass. Sixteen measured payloads unchanged by JSON redaction hardening; rejection boundaries pass.

attempts.action: Check redacted tracked outputs and synchronize canonical repository
attempts.expected_effect: Publish reviewable report and metering helper with no local evidence or credentials; verify clean local and remote main equality
attempts.result: Ten redacted delivery files checked; local evidence ignored and untracked. Commit c10e2b6 pushed; live remote main equals clean local HEAD. Final workflow closure metadata follows.
